answer: Farming becomes an oasis bet on surviving 80 epochs of grading, and every crystal settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 80 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
